pokedexEntries.dp: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.

pokedexEntries.pt: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.

pokedexEntries.la: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.
